q: What is the official one-command install for Linux / macOS / WSL2?
explanation: The official install is `curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | bash`. Windows native uses the PowerShell installer instead.

q: What does the installer automatically handle for you?
options: Python, Node, ripgrep and ffmpeg dependencies
explanation: The installer auto-handles Python, Node, ripgrep and ffmpeg so you mostly just run one command.

q: Which command starts the setup wizard after installation?
explanation: Simply running `hermes` launches the setup wizard. `hermes doctor` is a separate health-check command you use to keep a clean baseline.

q: What is the 'clean baseline' habit this lesson teaches?
options: Reinstall every week to remove old features
Get one clean `hermes doctor` run before adding any feature
Never install anything new once set up
Only use the desktop app and never the CLI
explanation: A clean `hermes doctor` before each feature means that when something breaks later, you know the new feature caused it — not a mystery.
